source.title: Preserved Self-Evaluation in Amnesia Supports Access to the Self through Introspective Computation

confidence_rationale: This review synthesises the observation that amnesic patients continue to make accurate trait self-judgements despite severe episodic memory impairment, and proposes 'introspective computation' as a non-declarative route of access to self-knowledge. The bearing on MECH-079 is that the stable component of selfhood in these patients survives the loss of exactly the hippocampal-dependent machinery the claim nominates as its substrate, which is a second independent route to the same conclusion the Klein and Nichols entry reaches: the self-continuity the claim wants to explain is not downstream of hippocampal map integrity in the way the chain requires. Held at only 0.5, distinctly lower than the other weakening entries, for three reasons that all cut the same way: it is a review rather than primary data, so it contributes no independent measurement; accurate trait self-judgement is a semantic self-knowledge measure, which is not the phenomenal continuity MECH-079 is about and is arguably the operational leg the R7 disposition says the claim conflates with it; and the proposed 'introspective computation' mechanism is a hypothesis the review advances rather than a result it establishes.
failure_signatures: The measure preserved in these patients is accurate trait self-judgement, i.e. semantic self-knowledge. That is neither phenomenal continuity nor map-dependent episodic retrieval, so the entry weakens the claim only on the reading that trait-level self-stability is part of what MECH-079 means to explain. On the narrower reading where the claim is strictly about phenomenal continuity, this entry is close to orthogonal.

This is a review, and the primary patient data it synthesises is largely from the authors' own group. It therefore adds theoretical framing and convergence rather than independent evidential weight, and must not be counted as a separate data point alongside the primary entries in this directory.

'Introspective computation' is proposed as an alternative access route to self-knowledge, not demonstrated. The review's own molecular and anatomical mechanism discussion is speculative, so the positive half of its proposal cannot be cited as evidence for any specific REE mechanism.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Across the amnesia literature, patients with severe episodic memory impairment nonetheless make accurate judgements about their own personality traits, so memory impairment alone does not prevent accurate trait self-knowledge. The authors propose that access to the self is achieved not only through declarative retrieval but through an 'introspective computation' route, and discuss candidate anatomical and molecular substrates for it.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-079 nominates stable hippocampal map geometry as the substrate whose persistence yields identity persistence. These patients have lost the hippocampal-dependent machinery and retain a stable, accurate self-model at the trait level. That is a dissociation in the same direction as the Klein and Nichols case but at a different level of description: there, content was present and ownership absent; here, the map-dependent retrieval route is absent and self-stability is present. For REE the reading is that whatever supports a persistent self-model may be substantially independent of the anchor/map retrieval path, and that a V3 perturbation of anchor geometry could therefore leave a trait-level self-model intact while telling us nothing about the claim -- which matters directly for designing the falsifier MECH-079 currently lacks.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The preserved measure is semantic trait self-knowledge, not phenomenal continuity, so on a strict reading of MECH-079 this entry is nearly orthogonal and only weakens the claim on the broader reading where trait-level self-stability counts as part of the target phenomenon. It is also a review, largely of its own group's patient work, so it supplies convergence and framing rather than independent measurement, and its 'introspective computation' proposal is a hypothesis rather than a finding.
mapping.source_context: Review of human amnesia studies of trait self-judgement, with a proposed non-declarative access mechanism; authors' own patient series prominent in the synthesised evidence.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality 0.45: a review in a mid-tier open-access venue, synthesising in substantial part the authors' own primary work, and advancing a speculative mechanism alongside the observation. Mapping fidelity 0.5 -- the dissociation is in the right direction and concerns human selfhood directly, but the preserved measure is semantic rather than phenomenal, which is the very distinction the claim's R7 disposition turns on. Transfer risk 0.4: human-to-REE at the level of an argument about which substrate carries self-stability, with no species transfer, but with a real risk that the level of description does not correspond to anything REE currently records.
